vocabulary.definition: to become proficient or skilled in something
vocabulary.example: After years of practice, she was able to master the art of painting.

vocabulary.definition: a strong desire to know or learn something
vocabulary.example: Her curiosity about space led her to study astronomy.

vocabulary.definition: to reveal or disclose something previously hidden
vocabulary.example: The artist unveiled his latest masterpiece at the gallery opening.

vocabulary.definition: a journey or adventure undertaken in search of something
vocabulary.example: The knight embarked on a quest to find the legendary sword.

vocabulary.definition: money set aside for a specific purpose or project
